props.title: Join the Preferred Vendor List | Signet Artists
props.description: Photographers, planners, videographers, caterers, florists and venues: a free listing with a link to your site, for people whose work we've seen.

notes._note: The vendor application page, 2026-09-20, a spoke of /preferred-vendors/ (the list is the hub, this is the way onto it). Drafted to the global copy law; Daniel edits after. Anyone with the link can apply (Daniel, 2026-09-20), so the page is indexed and the form is open. The offer is the listing itself: a card with the city, his two sentences and a dofollow link to their site, free, with nothing asked in return. The music library the handoff offered is dead ('i don't want to offer a music library anymore'), so nothing here promises one. The CTA is the Google Form in site.json brand.forms.vendor, owned by Daniel's own account; the starting price it asks for never publishes back. No nav key.

props.title: Join the Preferred Vendor List.
props.lede: Our clients ask us who to call for photography, video, planning, catering, flowers and a venue, and we’d rather give them a name we trust than a search result. We book the music for weddings, private parties and corporate events in Denver, Boulder, Colorado Springs, Fort Collins, Vail, Beaver Creek, Aspen, Breckenridge, Telluride, Steamboat Springs, Winter Park and Crested Butte, so the people on this list work the same towns we do.

headingText.html: The list stays short, with a few names in each category, and we pick people whose work we’ve seen. If you’re listed, you get a card on this site with your city, a couple of sentences on what you do best and the kind of event you suit, and a link straight to your website. The listing is free, and we don’t ask for anything in return.
Tell us about your business and we’ll take a look.

props._notes:
The vendor's page. Why we keep a list, how short it is, what being on
     it gets them, and the one action. Nothing here asks the vendor for a
     referral, a listing or a link.

props.label: Trusted and booked by
props._notes:
The client strip, sitewide. A vendor weighing the form sees who
     already books through Signet.

props.title: Apply to the list.
props.lede: The form takes about five minutes: your category, where you work, your website and two recent events. We read every application, and if you’re a fit we’ll write back and put you on.

props.html: Anyone with this link can apply, so pass it along to someone whose work you’d vouch for.

props._notes: The page's own close: the form, and the fact that the link is open.
